thread:
Anna (release): Canaries blocked for release v2.14.3 — deploy-bot flagged SBOM provenance header mismatch and a new HIGH CVE from dependency xyz-lib.
Jordan (sre): seeing elevated error rate on canary 2. Traffic was ~3% then dropped, probably retries.
Tamara (sec): CVE-2026-1234 in xyz-lib. POC shows local RCE only with LRU cache enabled. Blocking by policy unless mitigated.
Mike (eng): we can build a patched wheel that disables the LRU path; quick patch + rebuild takes ~90m. Alternative: pin to older xyz-lib 1.8.2 which has no CVE but regresses perf.
Anna (release): Options: 1) pin and proceed 2) hotpatch canary 3) hold until next change window (24h). Need sec approval for pin/exception.
Tamara (sec): We can allow a temporary canary-only exception if patch goes to canary within 2h and we enable runtime sandboxing + egress block to be safe. Require commit hash and audit of backport.
Linh (legal): confirm no export control or third-party license issues with pin/backport. If we pin, need a license record in the release notes.
Jordan (sre): If we allow canary-only hotpatch, we want automatic rollback if error rate >1.5% or latency p50 increases >200ms. Can we wire that into the deploy policy?
Mike (eng): yes, canary policy supports conditional fallback. Sample config I pushed:
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  rollback_on:
    - error_rate: 1.5
    - p50_increase_ms: 200
  fallback: stable
```
Anna (release): deploy-bot, what's the current gate status and who needs to sign off for an exception?
deploy-bot: release v2.14.3: gate=SBOM_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH, vuln=CVE-2026-1234(HIGH). Actions available: pin-package, patch-canary, hold. Approvals needed: sec-team + release-manager.
Tamara (sec): I approve a canary-only hotpatch plan provided: commit hash, timeline (<=120m), and SRE rollback rules set. I'll add an audit ticket.
Anna (release): @Jordan please enable canary policy and monitor. @Mike start the patch build and post the commit hash here. If patch not ready in 90m, we pivot to pin plan.
Mike (eng): starting build now. ETA ~70m. commit: `a1b2c3d4` (wip). Will post full artifact and SBOM when done.
Jordan (sre): enabled canary policy and alerting. I'll put temporary dashboard and pager threshold.
Linh (legal): noted. I'll add license note template to the release notes doc.
Anna (release): OK proceeding with canary hotpatch path. Tagging this thread for the release log. :white_check_mark:
